---
Vendored locally (2026-09-25) from npm package `jsqr` (latest, downloaded
via jsdelivr, minified with terser) — fallback decoder for the QR scanner
feature, used only when the browser-native BarcodeDetector API is
unavailable. Never loaded from a CDN, same convention as vendor/pdf.min.js.
Global exposed: `jsQR(imageData, width, height)`.
